title: Perth, Western Australia — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Perth, Western Australia: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Perth is a city in Western Australia with a population of 2,125,114. Western Australia’s sun-drenched capital with stunning beaches, a booming mining economy, and Kings Park. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 265 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
